# roxy

A strict, programmable HTTP firewall: an egress proxy for untrusted workloads, or a gateway in front of the APIs your clients call.

- [Overview](/index.md): roxy is a strict, programmable HTTP firewall: an egress proxy for untrusted workloads, or a gateway in front of the APIs your clients call.
- [Quickstart](/quickstart.md): Watch generated traffic go through roxy with an auth check, a per-user token quota and an inspect_sentinel sidecar, against a scripted model.
- [Changelog](/changelog.md)
- [Sandbox containment](/guides/containment.md): Run roxy as the only way out of a sandbox: the workload points HTTPS_PROXY at roxy's proxy port, trusts roxy's CA, and the network gives it no other route.
- [HTTP gateway](/guides/gateway.md): Put roxy in front of the APIs your clients call: a load balancer terminates TLS, an http listener takes each request, and rules route it by host and inject the real key.
- [Run roxy](/guides/run.md)
- [Node mode](/guides/node-mode.md): Run roxy without a config file: it enrols with a control plane, leases its policy and secrets, and sends its flow log back.
- [Operations](/guides/operations.md)
- [Managing the CA](/guides/ca-certificates.md)
- [Testing a policy](/guides/testing-a-policy.md)
- [Writing addons](/guides/writing-addons.md)
- [How roxy works](/design/how-it-works.md): One exchange through roxy: decrypt and parse, the addons, the rules, the upstream connection, and the response back the same way, with every step written to the flow log.
- [Threat model and guarantees](/design/threat-model.md)
- [Policy evaluation](/design/policy-evaluation.md): How the rules decide an exchange: one decision before the request is forwarded, further checks as the bytes stream, and deny always wins.
- [Addon model](/design/addon-model.md): What an addon is: a step every exchange it runs on streams through, in both directions. How addons are ordered, what they are held to, and what the modes mean.
